notes.title: Update Fix 4/20/2024
notes.content: - Shift wasn't being accepted as a 'thrust' command in the screen before level 26. That has been fixed

notes.title: Update Notes 4/19/2024
notes.content:
- Added a 0.5 second buffer after a level resets before the reset button can be used again to prevent double resets after black holes
- Added shift as another 'thrust' key
- Made the runtimer display final time during credits and finishing screens

notes.title: Colors Update! 4/17/2024
notes.content:
In a game with as few colors as ours, what started as a simple colorblind request became an exciting feature instead: Asteroid Drift can now be played in Yellow and Blue.

In the Options menu, you'll find a colorblind toggle which changes the color of the game's default green walls, so folks with red-green distinction issues can have a more pleasant experience. 

The option swaps between "OFF" for green, then "YELLOW" and "BLUE" for, well, yellow and blue.

Hope you enjoy these new color options, and Nick's really looking for a challenger, so keep working on those speedruns!

notes.title: Update Notes 4/15/2024
notes.content: Added a 'colorblind' toggle that makes the walls in the level Yellow to alleviate the red forcefield looking similar to the green walls

notes.title: Rumble Added! Update Notes 4/14/2024
notes.content:
- Controller Rumble/Vibration Toggle added to options menu, "ON" by default
- Cursor Removed in fullscreen
- Bug fixed where retry was pressed by accident if left was held at the end of a level

notes.title: "Smooth Resolution" Option is fixed! Update Notes 4/10/2024
notes.content:
- Performance enhancements to line drawing to help low-end PCs

Bug fixes:
- Fixed a bug where 'gold' achievements were unlocking with difficulty modifiers turned on
- Fixed a bug where turning "Smooth" off and on distorted text.
- Fixed a bug where swapping fullscreen and windowed with 'Smooth' resolution option distorted text.

notes.title: Update Notes 4/4/2024 fix
notes.content: Last version had the wrong name attached to the exe, apologies if the game was crashing on startup

notes.title: Update Notes 4/4/2024
notes.content: Replaced exclusive fullscreen with Borderless fullscreen to alleviate certain performance oddities

notes.title: Update Notes 4/3/2024
